python - <<'PY'
import json, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pathlib import Path

base = Path('/app/benchmark')
out = Path('/app/output/result.png')
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

task = json.loads((base/'task_input.json').read_text())
data = json.loads((base/'source_data.json').read_text())

goal = task.get('goal', [])
style = task.get('style', {})

d = data['corporate_earnings']['data']
dot = [x for x in d if x['era']=='Dot-com']
ai = [x for x in d if x['era']=='AI']

dot_avg = sum(x['earnings_bn'] for x in dot)/len(dot)
ai_avg = sum(x['earnings_bn'] for x in ai)/len(ai)
ratio = ai_avg/dot_avg

plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12,7), dpi=200)
fig.patch.set_facecolor('#ffffff')
ax.set_facecolor('#fbfcfe')

categories = ['Dot-com\n(1997–2002)', 'AI\n(2021–2024)']
vals = [dot_avg, ai_avg]
colors = ['#8da0cb', '#1f4e79']

bars = ax.bar(categories, vals, color=colors, width=0.55, edgecolor='#2f3e46', linewidth=1.0, label='Average annual net income')

for b,v in zip(bars, vals):
    ax.text(b.get_x()+b.get_width()/2, v + max(vals)*0.015, f'${v:,.1f}B', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=12, color='#1b263b', fontweight='bold')

ax.set_title('AI-Era Tech Earnings Vastly Exceed Dot-com Era', fontsize=20, fontweight='bold', color='#0d1b2a', pad=16)
ax.set_ylabel('Average Annual Net Income (Billion USD)', fontsize=13, color='#1b263b')
ax.set_xlabel('Market Era', fontsize=12, color='#1b263b', labelpad=8)

ax.legend(loc='upper left', frameon=True, facecolor='white', edgecolor='#d0d7de')
ax.set_axisbelow(True)
ax.grid(axis='y', color='#d9e2ec', linewidth=0.8)
ax.grid(axis='x', visible=False)

ax.text(0.98, 0.92, f'AI / Dot-com average = {ratio:.1f}×', transform=ax.transAxes,
        ha='right', va='top', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.35', facecolor='#e8f1fa', edgecolor='#7aa6d1'))

goal_text = goal[0] if isinstance(goal, list) and goal else ''
if goal_text:
    fig.text(0.01, 0.01, f"Goal: {goal_text}", fontsize=9, color='#4a5568')

fig.text(0.99, 0.01, 'Source: source_data.json (corporate_earnings)', ha='right', fontsize=9, color='#4a5568')

for spine in ['top', 'right']:
    ax.spines[spine].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['left'].set_color('#9aa5b1')
ax.spines['bottom'].set_color('#9aa5b1')

plt.tight_layout(rect=(0,0.03,1,1))
plt.savefig(out, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close(fig)
print(out)
PY

import json
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

base = Path('/app/benchmark')
out = Path('/app/output/result.png')
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

task = json.loads((base/'task_input.json').read_text())
data = json.loads((base/'source_data.json').read_text())

goal = task.get('goal', [])

d = data['corporate_earnings']['data']
dot = [x for x in d if x['era']=='Dot-com']
ai = [x for x in d if x['era']=='AI']
dot_avg = sum(x['earnings_bn'] for x in dot)/len(dot)
ai_avg = sum(x['earnings_bn'] for x in ai)/len(ai)
ratio = ai_avg/dot_avg

W,H = 1600,1000
img = Image.new('RGB',(W,H),'#ffffff')
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

def font(size,bold=False):
    paths = ['/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf' if bold else '/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf']
    for p in paths:
        try: return ImageFont.truetype(p,size)
        except: pass
    return ImageFont.load_default()

f_title=font(54,True); f_sub=font(30,False); f_axis=font(28,True); f_label=font(24,False); f_tick=font(22,False); f_small=font(18,False); f_bold=font(24,True)

margin=120
chart_left, chart_top = 200, 220
chart_right, chart_bottom = 1450, 820

# Title
title='AI-Era Tech Earnings Vastly Exceed Dot-com Era'
draw.text((W//2,70),title,fill='#0d1b2a',font=f_title,anchor='mm')

# Plot background
draw.rectangle((chart_left, chart_top, chart_right, chart_bottom), fill='#f8fafc', outline='#d0d7de', width=2)

# Axes
draw.line((chart_left, chart_bottom, chart_right, chart_bottom), fill='#4b5563', width=3)
draw.line((chart_left, chart_top, chart_left, chart_bottom), fill='#4b5563', width=3)

# Y scale
y_max = max(ai_avg, dot_avg)*1.2
for i in range(6):
    v = y_max*i/5
    y = chart_bottom - int((v/y_max)*(chart_bottom-chart_top))
    draw.line((chart_left, y, chart_right, y), fill='#e2e8f0', width=1)
    draw.text((chart_left-20,y), f'{v:,.0f}', fill='#334155', font=f_tick, anchor='rm')

# Bars
cats=['Dot-com\n(1997–2002)','AI\n(2021–2024)']
vals=[dot_avg, ai_avg]
colors=['#8da0cb','#1f4e79']
bar_w=220
x_positions=[550,1050]

for x,v,c,cat in zip(x_positions,vals,colors,cats):
    h=int((v/y_max)*(chart_bottom-chart_top))
    y0=chart_bottom-h
    draw.rectangle((x-bar_w//2,y0,x+bar_w//2,chart_bottom), fill=c, outline='#1f2937', width=2)
    draw.text((x,y0-16), f'${v:,.1f}B', fill='#111827', font=f_bold, anchor='ms')
    c1,c2=cat.split('\n')
    draw.text((x, chart_bottom+40), c1, fill='#111827', font=f_label, anchor='mm')
    draw.text((x, chart_bottom+72), c2, fill='#111827', font=f_label, anchor='mm')

# Axis labels
draw.text((95,(chart_top+chart_bottom)//2), 'Average Annual Net Income (Billion USD)', fill='#1f2937', font=f_axis, anchor='mm')
draw.text((W//2,900), 'Market Era', fill='#1f2937', font=f_axis, anchor='mm')

# Legend
lx,ly=230,145
draw.rectangle((lx,ly,lx+30,ly+30), fill='#8da0cb', outline='#1f2937')
draw.text((lx+40,ly+15),'Dot-com average annual net income', fill='#1f2937', font=f_label, anchor='lm')
draw.rectangle((lx+620,ly,lx+650,ly+30), fill='#1f4e79', outline='#1f2937')
draw.text((lx+660,ly+15),'AI average annual net income', fill='#1f2937', font=f_label, anchor='lm')

# Insight callout
box=(980,250,1420,340)
draw.rounded_rectangle(box, radius=14, fill='#e8f1fa', outline='#7aa6d1', width=2)
draw.text((1200,295), f'AI / Dot-com average = {ratio:.1f}×', fill='#0f172a', font=f_sub, anchor='mm')

if goal:
    draw.text((20,H-30), f'Goal: {goal[0]}', fill='#475569', font=f_small, anchor='ls')
draw.text((W-20,H-30), 'Source: source_data.json (corporate_earnings)', fill='#475569', font=f_small, anchor='rs')

img.save(out)
print(out)
